Este es probablemente el último video que suba a este canal.

The ending especially moved me, and I had a small vision which I surprisingly managed to execute quite swiftly. it's probably my 2nd smallest level so far, though I believe one of my more artistic works and I am proud of what I've made. I had a lot of fun as well, though I fear about the reception a lot, since I don't typically show off this genre of levels publicly. 

Give Requiem a listen, it's such an incredible album

A little late to the third anniversary but better late than never. TOTC was always the black sheep on the TM channel to me. This is another old work started way back in 2.1. I always liked listening to Clubstep; thus, I felt the need of creating a layout with it. Again, I occasionally come back to this and place a few blocks.

As you can see, it is a 1.9 gameplay with tons of fakes and confusing factors. I feel like 1.9 gameplay is inherently simple, you do not have many tools to create mechanically impressive layouts. Instead, I try to implement the fakes in 1.9 to actually blend the old memory levels and my current style (although not that current, this is quite old). This is heavily influenced by Clubstep and Tartarus, as you might recognize.

I understand you probably weren’t expecting this from the same creator who made two of the silliest levels in GD history. I really enjoyed creating Opium, as it was so different from my typical style. I wanted to try something new, focusing on atmosphere, song representation, and symbolism.

I am blessed that substance abuse hasn’t played a significant role in my life, but friends around me that I see every day and care about are in a constant struggle. This level is a story about addiction, but from an outside point of view. Rather than being told from the perspective of the addict, it’s told from the perspective of a family member. 7987.author: Motleyorc
7987.desc:
ID: 143517648

After ~3 years, this level is finally finished! I can't say much other than this project has gone through development hell for a very long time; it was basically a day 1 2.2 project, and was intended to be EXTREMELY long in scope (50+ rooms instead of 9...)

I built my room in very early 2.2, it's somewhat unimpressive (partially due to me not having touched the editor in years at that point), as well as some extremely tight object/group constraints.

I am extremely happy with how this level turned out, massive props to Fungifity and Subwoofer for their work on this. I wish I could have been more involved with the development of this level, but I am happy with my contributions (alongside with helping a lot with testing!).

8916.author: erquillo1
8916.desc:
I started this project in February under the name 'Thin Line'. Initially, it was intended to be one of several low-effort releases on my birthday (4 August), but I quickly became attached to the idea of entering it into the Duality Gauntlet Contest. With Middle Window, I have tried to portray real life and its regular ups and downs.

The level begins with a glass prism, which symbolises how something as dull as white light can transform into a captivating display of colour. In case it wasn't already clear, I tried to associate the monochromatic palette (black and white) with negative feelings, while the colours represent the joy and happiness that we always need. 

The second section features a substantial element: the Eye, which represents how others and you perceive yourself. We sometimes allow the thoughts of others and ourselves to in...

When I first started this level, I was just making it for fun. I didn't have a release date in mind or even know when I'd finish it. As I kept working on it little by little, a friend was watching me build it and said, Why don't you make it for Duality? I replied, Nah, why would I? haha. 9037.desc:
Our hypothetical entry for the Duality Gauntlet, the theme was essentially 2 players, blending two dimensional planes in each section Blocks in 2D and background in 3D, or vice versa, and working with two colors.

Since we’re not kids anymore and live in a third-world country we didn’t have much time to fully focus on the project. Even so, we achieved a very satisfying result for just two months of work on the level.

The deadline and the object limit didn’t match the level of polish we wanted to achieve, so we decided to cancel the entry and finish things more carefully at our own pace.

9057.author: Radar
9057.desc:
Creating with limitations can often lead to some incredibly memorable experiences. Made with entirely 2.0 restrictions, "Princess Demon" by BreadKing, is an outstanding entry for the Duality Gauntlet contest. There are so many original 2.0 levels that this level pays homage to, it’s packed full of nostalgia and creativity. Upon immediate viewing you can tell that this level calls back to a much more primitive time in the game's history, when creators and players often had to use their own imagination and suspend their disbelief to tell what was being shown within levels. It’s immediate to me that this level was made as a love letter to the game and levels within it, showing a deep appreciation for art made inside the editor. 

BreadKing takes the theme of duality and plays on it heavily for the levels theme and story telling. Out of all t...

wow, what a rollercoaster this one was...

To start, we went into the level with great motivation and nice work.
Later on, our team leader N3ptune had some major issues with his Discord account, which led to him having no communication with us at all. Because of this, he was unfortunately not able to help with this layout, which led to me and Borito taking over as team leader. We ultimately made the decision to cut some parts out of the song, because we knew we weren't going to have the manpower to make the full layout without N3ptune's help.

However, after all of this, I'm very proud to see that we were able to pull through with this one!

В прошлом году я планировал сделать геймплей на твой др, но что-то не сложилось, за это я очень сильно извиняюсь. Да я начинал его строить, но сил для завершения не хватило. Я думал насчет того, чтобы достроить его в этом году на твой день рождения, но все-таки решил сделать новый гп под новый сонг. 
Вообщем, я желаю тебе всего самого наилучшего и пройти слаутер! С днем рождения бебзена.

I can’t believe I actually finished this.

Hello everyone! I know that many of you were not expecting me to release a new level today, so surprise!!! Surprisingly, this level actually has around the same amount of in-editor hours as my other level 'Touch the Orbs Bub."
